question: Does retained equal-quadrant replacement remove enough live-leaf and random-selection wiring to make count and selection meaningful artist edits, while a content substitution preserves the exact leaf geometry?
decision: Keep this private walkthrough unless root review finds a useful capability boundary; no public operation, default, range, or validation bound is authorized by these images.
hypothesis: At seed42, changing 100 to 200 replacements or changing the selected live-leaf set changes the retained arrangement; replacing panels with small content grids preserves every leaf id and bound; an explicit 2x3 transfer shows whether shared replacement machinery is necessary.

fixed_profile.content_rule: panel with central mark, or fixed 3x3 small-mark grid inside each retained leaf
fixed_profile.panel_inset: min(1 px, 5% of leaf min(width,height)); applied identically to every content variant so every drawn panel has positive dimensions

chooser.status: private investigation compatibility stream; not an eventual portable default
chooser.selection_draw: exactly one nextFloat per seeded replacement
chooser.replacement_order: select existing index; append TL, TR, BR, BL; remove selected parent
chooser.palette_prelude: none; private stream divergence from source prelude

parameter.name: replacement count, selected live-leaf set, and content substitution

variants.change: 100 equal-quadrant replacements; first-half live-list chooser; panel-mark content
only replacement count changes from 100 to 200; first-half live-list chooser; panel-mark content
only eligible selection set changes from first-half to full live list at 100 replacements; panel-mark content
same 100 first-half geometry and stable ids; only panel-mark content changes to a fixed 3x3 small-mark grid
explicit stable-id plan: replace root with 2x3 grid, then replace child id3 with 2x3 grid; same content-grid drawing rule

comparison: Before any render, require positive finite bounds, coverage, non-overlapping interiors, deterministic leaf order, and geometry identity between 100half and same100half-contentgrid. Root inspects all five images after one registered executor attempt; compare normalized RGB MAE/changed fraction from 100half for the three seeded edits and record geometry hashes/counts. The explicit transfer is a design test, not a single-variable comparison.
constraints: Private diagnostic only; no public operation implementation, catalog entry, candidate disposition, or ledger mutation.
Exactly five images in one registered attempt, one render per listed state, no automatic retries or sixth image.
A single root-approved executor must serialize Processing rendering; this task compiles/runs numeric preflight only and does not render.
No assets, fonts, source-corpus copy, or CP1/CP2/CP3 artifact change.
Treat java.util.Random as a private investigation stream, not a portable RNG selection or compatibility promise.

retention_criteria.count: Only investigate a count control if root inspection finds 100 and 200 legibly distinct without treating either as a recommended bound.
retention_criteria.selection: Only investigate selected-live-leaf choice if root inspection finds a meaningful geometry distinction; do not describe a direction as size bias without reconciling source evidence.
retention_criteria.content: Only investigate retained region output if the content-grid image has exactly the 100half geometry and changes only content.
retention_criteria.explicit_transfer: Keep explicit replacement private if its 2x3 transfer is ordinary example glue; consider a second route only if it avoids reimplementing identity/replacement semantics.

rendering: not started; root single-executor approval required
